text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, alprazolam 0.5 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list. Current inventory across three sites provides 19.8 to 26.9 days on hand. Corvale General has the lowest coverage at 19.8 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include alprazolam as of 2026-10-21. Aurobindo Pharma Limited, a registered plant for alprazolam, received an OAI classification on 2019-12-26 after an inspection ending 2019-09-27, and a VAI classification on 2022-08-04 after an inspection ending 2022-05-10.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term but Corvale General is approaching the internal reorder threshold. Proactive purchasing from manufacturers not on the FDA shortage list is warranted to maintain continuity.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place initial order with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC (Amneal Pharmaceuticals of NY plant); requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Par Health USA, LLC (PH HEALTH plant) as secondary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Actavis Pharma, Inc., and Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC for tertiary options; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report changes to P&T Committee; requires P&T Committee acknowledgment.

Not recommended: Delaying purchase until any site falls below 14 days on hand.
